caption:
Someone close became a stranger. But the wedge between you didn't appear on its own — and it can be pulled back out. (Galatians 6:13 devotional)

When someone close turns into a stranger, you blame the person across from you and miss the wedge that was driven between you. But every division runs the same ancient script — a lie, then a split, then separation — and its real aim is to pull your eyes off Him. In Christ that script gets reversed: He made reconciliation your ministry and tore down the dividing wall, so the "other" can become "us" again through truth, repentance, and grace.

📌 Save this for the relationship that quietly split
📩 Send it to someone estranged from a person they loved
